title: The augmented complex of free modules on the powers of a nonempty set is exact
statement: Let $A$ be a ring and $S$ a set. For $p\geq0$ let $C_p(S;A)=A[S^{p+1}]$ be the free left $A$-module on the set $S^{p+1}$ of $(p+1)$-tuples, with basis elements $[(s_0,\ldots,s_p)]$, and let $d:C_{p+1}(S;A)\to C_p(S;A)$ be the $A$-linear map $[(s_0,\ldots,s_{p+1})]\mapsto\sum_{j=0}^{p+1}(-1)^j[(s_0,\ldots,\widehat{s_j},\ldots,s_{p+1})]$; let $\varepsilon:C_0(S;A)\to A$ be the $A$-linear map $[s]\mapsto1$. Then $d\circ d=0$ and $\varepsilon\circ d=0$, and if $S$ is nonempty the augmented complex $\cdots\to C_2(S;A)\to C_1(S;A)\to C_0(S;A)\xrightarrow{\varepsilon}A\to0$ is exact in every degree; in particular $H_p(C_\bullet(S;A))=0$ for $p>0$ and $\varepsilon$ induces $H_0(C_\bullet(S;A))\cong A$. (If $S$ is empty, every $C_p(S;A)$ is $0$.) Concretely, for a chosen $s\in S$ the maps $h:C_p(S;A)\to C_{p+1}(S;A)$, $[(s_0,\ldots,s_p)]\mapsto[(s,s_0,\ldots,s_p)]$, and $h:A\to C_0(S;A)$, $1\mapsto[s]$, form a contracting homotopy of the augmented complex.

split_report.summary: Checked against Stacks 03AT (last paragraph of the proof: the extended complex Z[S^3]->Z[S^2]->Z[S]->Z->0 is exact for nonempty S by the homotopy n_(s_0..s_p) -> n_(s,s_0..s_p)) and 03F5 (coefficients O(V)). Statement kept (correct; the empty case is stated correctly as C_p = 0, the augmented complex then not being exact unless A = 0). Proof written in four steps: (1) d∘d = 0 and ε∘d = 0 by the sign cancellation on basis elements, elementary; (2) the empty case, elementary; (3) the homotopy identities dh+hd = id on C_p (p>=1), dh+hε = id on C_0, εh = id on A, computed on basis elements, elementary; (4) exactness and H_0 ≅ A from the contracting homotopy, using the new Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-contractible-complex-acyclic (Homotopy.homologyMap_eq + homologyMap_id/zero + IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero + exactAt_iff_isZero_homology). The item itself is not a Mathlib leaf: Mathlib has the construction only for S a monoid with k commutative (Rep.standardComplex.forget₂ToModuleCatHomotopyEquiv), and for a general set it would be assembled from four pieces plus an identification of the alternating face map complex with the explicit differential (analogue of Rep.standardComplex.d_eq), recorded in mathlib_searches as the expected Lean route.
